limits: Subsampling draws from the existing evaluation pool, whose composition may differ from newly measured combinations; this is the main external-validity limit.
The 80 percent threshold and the alpha of 0.05 are conventions, not requirements.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim.

the_number.statement: a prospective test needs about 1,600 measured (cell x drug-pair) combinations for 80 percent power
the_number.reading: power climbs steadily and only crosses eighty percent at the largest size tested. At two hundred combinations - a size that sounds generous - power is 0.46, so a study of that size would be a coin flip for detecting an effect that is really there.

the_estimate_is_not_biased_by_subsamplin.reading: the point estimate sits between 0.137 and 0.153 across a thirty-two-fold range of measurement counts, so subsampling changes the precision and not the target
the_estimate_is_not_biased_by_subsamplin.what_does_change: the interval width falls from 0.556 at fifty keys to 0.124 at sixteen hundred, roughly as the square root of k

what_1600_means_in_practice.conversion: with about 125 cell lines per drug pair, 1,600 key-level combinations is roughly thirteen drug pairs measured across all cells
what_1600_means_in_practice.so: a prospective verification is a real screening campaign, not a small exercise
what_1600_means_in_practice.why_this_matters_for_the_programme: the promotion criterion requires cross-dataset replication, and this number is the first estimate of what that replication would cost

a_possible_retrospective_explanation_wor.observation: every cross-dataset attempt in this programme failed (C78, C89)
a_possible_retrospective_explanation_wor.hypothesis: if those arenas had far fewer than sixteen hundred usable combinations in the both-unseen regime, failure was the expected outcome on power grounds alone, independently of whether the claim is true
a_possible_retrospective_explanation_wor.status: NOT yet checked - this is a hypothesis about why those attempts failed, and it needs the actual per-arena key counts before it can be stated
a_possible_retrospective_explanation_wor.why_I_am_recording_it: it would convert 'cross-dataset replication is blocked by resource' into a specific, checkable arithmetic claim
